title: P1 research-record contract smoke study
hypothesis: Fail-closed linked manifests can produce a deterministic, self-verifying research result bundle that preserves the hypothesis, fixed use-case gate, exact revisions, findings, and limitations.

use_case.claim: Produce a reproducible publication record for one bounded OrcaColony research experiment.

baseline.label: Ad hoc research notes
baseline.description: Unlinked prose and terminal output without a validated machine-readable result contract.

primary_metric.label: Result-bundle verification rate
primary_metric.description: Fraction of repeated builds with byte-identical files and valid recorded checksums.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Research contract focused tests
repeated_validation_suite.description: Focused manifest, evidence, deterministic-output, and CLI tests.

final_holdout_suite.label: Real CLI result-bundle proof
final_holdout_suite.description: A clean command-line run over the committed fixture followed by checksum verification.

guardrails.label: Stable v0.1 isolation
guardrails.description: The research-record slice must not change the proven campaign, optimizer, trust, or release paths.

independent_variables.label: Research recording contract
independent_variables.description: Replace ad hoc notes with linked, validated, deterministic study artifacts.

controlled_variables.label: Fixture inputs
controlled_variables.description: Keep study, experiment, and evidence payloads fixed across repeated bundle builds.

controlled_variables.label: Existing v0.1 runtime
controlled_variables.description: Do not alter any campaign execution or numerical contract while adding research records.
